main_text.p: bus, & commentariis elaboratissimis doctissimisque, ad me frequenter transmissis; damnum quod ex absentia tua sentio, resarcire, vel cum emolumento, satagis. Ego vero par pari referre non assuetus, hoc tibi pauxilluli laboris rependo; in eoque nostrae non communis φιλαδελφίας, & meae in te singularis observantiae, testamen publicum extare volui. Tu aequi bonique consules. Caeterum vive & vale, eius cui viuis ope & gratia; at ex fratris unici, ut tibi addictissimi sic & coniunctissimi voto. Taliaburgo Santonum, prid. Kal. Octobr. ann. M. D C. X X I V.
main_text.head: LIBER-

page.notes: The Greek word "φιλαδελφίας" is printed in the running text, reproduced as best read. The woodcut ornament below the heading is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is present and omitted. Text marked "vero" in the scan appears as "veiò"; read as "vero" with the printed spelling noted as uncertain in "veiò"[?].
